Creative Designs. Smart Solutions. Quality Craftsmanship.
Custom Home Renovation Experts Proudly Serving Twin Cities

At Wise Design & Remodel, we believe homes should be both beautiful and deeply personal. As a premier design-build firm based in the twin cities, we specialize in transforming homes with character into spaces that feel fresh, functional, and refined. 

Whether you’re restoring the charm of a century-old Craftsman or reimagining a more modern floor plan, our team brings together design, architecture, and construction under one roof - ensuring a seamless, collaborative experience from first sketch to final walk-through. If you value enduring craftsmanship, purposeful design, and a process grounded in trust, you’re in the right place. 

What We Do Best 

At Wise Design & Remodel, we specialize in designing and remodeling the spaces that matter most—the places where life happens. Each project begins with a thoughtful design process tailored to your home’s character and your vision for how it should feel and function. From there, our skilled team brings that vision to life with exceptional craftsmanship and attention to detail. 

What Our Clients Say 

A well-executed remodel is about more than finishes or floor plans—it’s about how you feel in your home, and how you're supported throughout the journey. At Wise Design & Remodel, we take pride in building lasting relationships with the homeowners we serve.  Our clients often tell us how much they value our thoughtful approach, clear communication, and dedication to getting every detail right. But don’t just take our word for it. 

Kitchens

More than a place to cook, your kitchen is where family gathers, conversations unfold, and everyday life begins. For a Kitchen Remodel St Paul, we design kitchens that are beautiful, efficient, and deeply personal—blending historic charm with modern convenience in every detail.

Your bathroom should be a place of restoration. For your Bathroom Remodel Saint Paul, we craft spaces that elevate your daily routines with calming finishes, thoughtful storage, and spa-like functionality, whether it's a luxurious primary suite or a well-appointed powder room.

Living Spaces

From cozy dens to open-concept family rooms, our Living Spaces Remodel Services help reimagine your home’s footprint to support the way you live now. This often means improving flow, increasing natural light, or reclaiming underused square footage.

MORE HAPPY HOMEOWNERS
Why Choose Wise Design & Remodel?

Renovating your home is a big decision. That’s why our team is built around making the process smoother, more inspiring, and more rewarding—from the first conversation to the final walkthrough. 

We’re a true design-build firm. That means architecture, interior design, project management, and skilled construction all under one roof. With Wise Design, you won’t juggle multiple vendors or worry about miscommunication between teams. Instead, you’ll work with one aligned group of experts who are focused on your goals—and deeply invested in your home. 

As one of the leading remodeling contractors in St. Paul, MN, we’re proud to offer a remodeling experience that’s as thoughtful as the spaces we create. 

What Sets Us Apart:

A Seamless Process

Tailored Design

Smart, Respectful Remodeling

A Collaborative Team

A Hands-On Showroom Experience

Your 1-Stop Design-Build Team

At the heart of Wise Design & Remodel is a small, experienced team of designers, builders, and project managers who care deeply about their craft and the people they serve. 

Every Wise Design project begins with a conversation—and often, that conversation is with founder Philip Hide. 

Phil’s approach to remodeling is rooted in decades of hands-on experience, much of it shaped by the historic homes of North London, where he grew up and launched his first remodeling business. In a city where homes were often built in the 1800s, every project required creative problem-solving, a deep respect for craftsmanship, and a sharp eye for detail. These early experiences laid the foundation for the thoughtful, heritage-minded approach that defines Wise Design today. 

After moving to Minnesota with his wife, Julianne, Phil founded Wise Design & Remodel in St. Paul to bring that same level of care and creativity to homes across the Twin Cities. He works closely with clients throughout the design-build process—offering practical insights, guiding decisions, and ensuring the final result feels both timeless and deeply personal. 

Phil believes that remodeling isn’t just about changing how a space looks. It’s about improving how it lives—while honoring everything you already love about your home. 

MEET THE TEAM
We look forward to hearing from you.

If you’re ready to reimagine your space—or just starting to explore what’s possible—we’d love to hear your ideas. Whether it’s a full kitchen renovation, a bathroom retreat, or a complete home transformation, Wise Design & Remodel is here to help you bring it to life. 

We invite you to connect with our team, visit our showroom in St. Paul, or schedule a consultation to begin your journey. 

Tell us about your project today!

Stunning Home Remodel

After relocating from New York City, Kirsten and her family purchased a classic fixer-upper with plans to transform the kitchen, mudroom, and 2.5 bathrooms including creating a seamless connection between their primary bedroom and a new ensuite bath. While other contractors encouraged them to rush the renovation before move-in, Phil offered a different approach: live in the home first to truly understand how they wanted it to function. That guidance made all the difference.

From initial inspiration to final finishes, Wise Design brought Kirsten’s vision to life with clean, respectful demolition, thoughtful product recommendations, and a full-service team that delivered craftsmanship and care at every step. “We would highly recommend Wise Design for a project like this we trusted Phil throughout the process and admire the quality of the work.”

“Whether it was a design element or architectural decision, Phil drew on all of his knowledge to guide us to the right decision with a lot of attention to detail.”

— Kristen

“Wise Design did a great job on the custom nature of this bar and the attention to detail.
We came up with a lot of really good ideas that make this a unique showpiece that everybody in my house comments on.”

— Michael

Custom Home Bar

As a cocktail enthusiast, Michael wanted a bar that was more than functional it needed to be a standout feature in his home. Tasked with transforming a compact basement corner into a fully equipped bar, the Wise Design team embraced the challenge with custom solutions and creative ingenuity. The design phase became a highlight of the process, as Michael collaborated closely with Phil and the team to craft a one-of-a-kind space tailored to his passion. Despite this being his first remodel, he was surprised at how seamless and clean the entire experience was, even while living in the home.

Wise Design delivered clever, space-saving features from a custom rollout section tailored to his liquor collection to layered lighting that highlights the stunning Patagonia granite. The result is both a functional bar and a conversation-worthy centerpiece.

Fresh, Open Kitchen

This renovation completely redefined how this young family lives and entertains. Wise Design helped turn a closed-off 100-year-old home into a bright, open space tailored for modern living. “Not only is this a new kitchen it has really transformed our entire living space on the main level.” From day one, the design process was collaborative and thorough, with Phil and the team guiding decisions while ensuring the final choices truly reflected the family’s vision.

Thoughtful design, clean workmanship, and friendly communication made the experience smooth even while the family was temporarily out of the home. The new kitchen now features a functional peninsula, custom cabinetry they love, and a layout that finally supports both daily family life and effortless entertaining.

“Not only is this a new kitchen—it has really transformed our entire living space on the main level. We have no regrets and everything is exactly the way we wanted it.”
“The staff at Wise Design are excellent. They all are very knowledgeable and professional. 
Even the contractors they used were all professional, all very friendly… made friends with my neighbors! We couldn’t ask for more.” 

— Mike & Gina

Full Scale Upgrades

What began as a modest kitchen renovation for Mike and Gina evolved into a full-scale upgrade that dramatically improved both form and function throughout their home. A small bump-out created space for an open, airy kitchen, while additional updates included a compact yet efficient mudroom, a stylish new powder room, and practical improvements like a new roof and gutters. Each addition was carefully integrated to enhance the home’s everyday livability without disrupting its original charm.

Our full-service design-build process made it easy to adapt as the project evolved. From custom cabinetry and hardware selections to smart layout refinements, every detail was thoughtfully considered to reflect the couple’s style and needs. The finished space is as beautiful as it is practical a cohesive blend of elegance, comfort, and smart upgrades that elevate daily life.

Wise Design & Remodel recently redesigned and remodeled our kitchen and dining room, and I can't say enough about how great Phil and his team are. This was our first major remodel, and Phil anticipated potential issues while keeping us informed throughout. The project stayed on budget and on schedule, and the management software made it easy to track everything. After this experience, I can’t imagine trusting anyone else for a remodel.

We had an excellent experience with Wise Design. Philip and team are creative, accountable, efficient, and client-oriented to design and build the best remodel for our space. The craftsmanship and attention to detail was excellent. We're grateful to have had them by our side throughout this process and there was always a high sense of trust. The end result is exactly what we envisioned and I almost don't want to recommend them since we have too many other projects ;)

Meet Your Team

Wise Design & Remodel is a Design-build remodeling company serving the Twin Cities and neighboring areas. Our team of dedicated professionals are experienced and passionate about their work. We pride ourselves on remodels that both function well and look amazing, while working hard to make the process as smooth and fun as possible. We look forward to hearing from you about your project.

Design Team

Philip Hide

FOUNDER, GENERAL CONTRACTOR

Philip was born & raised in North London, England, where he started his own remodeling business before bringing his expertise to Minnesota. As many of the homes in London were built in the 1800's, Phil truly specializes in designing smart, creative solutions for old homes without compromising their charm and historicity. Phil met his wife, Julianne, in London where she was studying abroad. They were married in 2007 and continued to live in London for 9 years before moving their family back to Minneapolis in 2014, where he founded Wise Design shortly thereafter. They have 3 children and a German Shepherd dog named Bear. 

Jason Miskowiec

ARCHITECT

Jason has over 15 years of Residential Design experience and holds a Master's in Architecture from the Illinois Institute of Technology, in addition to a Bachelor's in Architecture from the U of M. Working, studying and traveling to destinations such New York, Paris, Chicago, and Oaxaca have all contributed to the inspiration for design he brings to his home and work in Minneapolis. Jason is an avid Viking's fan and loves to travel, where his passions for food, architecture and culture converge. He keeps his office and apartment filled with plants and books, and occasionally brings his beloved dog, Remy, to visit the showroom.

Kim Aaron-Lehman

DESIGNER, KITCHEN & BATH SPECIALIST

Kim has been buying and renovating South Minneapolis homes for over a decade leading up to formally studying Kitchen & Bath Design and joining the Wise Design team. Prior to that, she taught Spanish at the university-level for 11 years and has lived abroad in 4 different countries from Latin America to Europe & the Middle East. As an artist, Kim dabbles in photography, furniture refinishing, painting, and ceramics, and stays busy with part-time property management, having fixed up and rented out 4 homes and a "Skoolie" over the years.

Production Team

Tim Leirness

PROJECT MANAGER

Tim has been in the remodeling industry for nearly 20 years and possesses extensive knowledge of both interior and exterior remodeling. Tim enthusiastically manages our projects with a friendly, client-centered approach. His organizational and communication skills are the key to keeping our operations running smoothly and our clients informed of the daily updates during the construction process. Tim is a devoted husband and father of two. In his free time, he enjoys working out, playing golf, and watching baseball.

Jhony Perez

PROJECT MANAGER, SITE SUPERVISOR

Jhony helps lead the team and supervises the projects. He is a skilled craftsman with over 20 years of experience. His kind and cheerful attitude is appreciated by our clients, who love having him on their projects. Jhony helps train the next generation to be as attentive to detail and proud of their work as he is. A fun fact about Jhony is that his family owns a coffee farm, he generously shares fresh coffee beans with the Wise Design family. Jhony is devoted to his wife and 3 daughters and recently became a Grandpa. 

Derrald Peterson

CABINET SPECIALIST

Derrald has been in the cabinet industry for over 40 years and brings a wealth of knowledge and expertise to the company. Over the years he has honed his cabinet making skills and partnered with many of the top designers in the Twin Cities, completing hundreds of kitchens and custom cabinetry projects. Derrald lives in Minneapolis, is happily married, and has 3 grown sons. He enjoys the outdoors, boating, and photography in his free time.

Nicholas Skarphol

TILING SPECIALIST 

Nick brings his passion for remodeling and expertise as both a Tiler and finish carpenter to the Wise Design Team. He pays close attention to the details and truly loves what he does. Nick’s friendly and caring attitude is always appreciated by our clients. He lives with his Fiancé and loves traveling and outdoor adventures.

Jonathan Kilian

FRAMING & CARPENTRY

Jonathan has come to us from Montpelier Vermont. He has been in the trades for over five years, with experience in the framing and flooring industries. His hobbies are playing guitar, camping, hiking, fly fishing and going to the gym. Jonathan has a passion and enthusiasm for remodeling and construction. He is such a great asset for our team that we forgive him for being a Boston Celtics fan (Go Wolves!).

Chris Dimitrievski

DRYWALL & CARPENTRY

Chris recently moved to the Twin Cities to be closer to his wife's family. His hobbies include Martial Arts, Hiking and Fishing (and remodeling). He is an avid tool collector and when it comes to tools, Chris follows this Mantra:  Better to have it and not need it, than need it and not have it! Chris loves all aspects of remodeling and is a fast learner. We are fortunate to have Chris on the team.

Administrative Team

Sheryll Storry

BOOKKEEPER

Sheryll has been with Wise Design and Remodel since 2018. She spent most of her career in public service, first teaching high school French, then working at Hennepin County, and later the Minnesota Department of Human Services.  After retiring in 2015, she went back to school to become a trained bookkeeper with a focus on the construction trades. While she loves working with numbers, her real passion is helping companies succeed by providing the necessary business intelligence gained from financial analysis. Some fun facts about Sheryll are that she’s an avid gardener, a grandma of 3 teen boys, and a world traveler. 

Julianne Hide

SHOWROOM MANAGER, DESIGN CONSULTANT

Julianne shares Philip’s passion for transforming homes into beautiful and functional living spaces. She helps manage the showroom at Wise Design and assists with designing. Julianne graduated from St. Kate’s University in St. Paul and met Phil in London during a term abroad. They married and lived together in London for 9 years before moving back to Minneapolis and continuing to raise their 3 kids here. Apart from the business, Julianne enjoys music and theatre, yoga and traveling, but most of all loves spending time with her family.

We look forward to hearing from you.

Creating Beautiful Living Spaces in St Paul

At Wise Design & Remodel, we create tailored living spaces that enhance how you live every day. With our tailored living spaces remodeling services and professional living room remodeling services in St. Paul, we help homeowners transform underused rooms or outdated layouts into inviting, functional areas that truly feel like home. 

Our living room remodeling projects focus on improving flow, comfort, and everyday functionality. Whether opening up a dining area or creating a flexible family space, our design-build team approaches every project with the same commitment to craftsmanship and thoughtful design. Each remodel is tailored to your home’s character and your family’s lifestyle, ensuring the finished space is both beautiful and enduring. 

Our Approach to Living Space Design

A successful remodel balances design with functionality. As your dedicated living space remodeler, We begin by learning how you use your home today and how you’d like it to serve you in the future. Do you need a welcoming area for entertaining? A cozy den for quiet evenings? A multipurpose space that adapts as your family grows? 

Through our living room interior design services, we help homeowners select finishes, lighting, and architectural details that maximize natural light and connect seamlessly to other rooms in the home. From flooring and built-ins to lighting and trim, every detail is chosen to elevate the overall design. The result is a space that looks timeless, works beautifully, and feels uniquely yours.

St Paul Living Spaces Renovation Ideas 

Every home has untapped potential, and often it’s the living spaces like bedrooms, dens, and living rooms that hold the greatest opportunity for transformation. At Wise Design & Remodel, we help clients reimagine these areas so they feel both functional and inspiring. Our living room renovation service is especially valuable for older homes that need thoughtful modernization while preserving character. We understand how to adapt historic homes, mid-century layouts, and modern builds to today’s lifestyles.

Some of the most impactful updates include: 

Opening floor plans to create better flow between living, dining, and kitchen areas 

Introducing natural light with strategically placed windows or expanded openings 

Updating fireplaces to serve as warm, inviting focal points 

Adding custom built-ins for storage that blends seamlessly into the architecture 

Designing flexible layouts that can adapt as your family’s needs change 

We also specialize in preserving character while modernizing, whether that means highlighting original woodwork or thoughtfully updating finishes to feel fresh but timeless. 

We look forward to hearing from you.

Every room in your home should reflect the way you live. If you’re ready to transform your living spaces into areas that are both beautiful and practical, our team is here to help.  

Connect with Wise Design & Remodel to begin your project or visit our St. Paul showroom for design inspiration. Together, we’ll create living spaces that feel timeless, personal, and built to last.

Whole Home & Multi-Room Remodeling in St. Paul
Reimagine Your Home with a Cohesive Design-Build Renovation

A whole-home or multi-room remodel allows you to improve several areas of your home through one coordinated renovation. Rather than updating one room at a time, many Twin Cities homeowners choose to renovate connected spaces together, creating a more cohesive design, improving functionality, and making the most of the home they already love.

Why Choose a Whole Home Remodel St. Paul?

Your home should support the way you live today, not the way it functioned decades ago. 

Many homeowners begin by considering a kitchen renovation or bathroom remodel, only to realize that other areas of the home could benefit from thoughtful improvements as well. By approaching the project as a complete renovation instead of a series of individual updates, you can create a home that feels unified from room to room. 

Whether you're remodeling two rooms or transforming your entire home, Wise Design & Remodel works with you to develop a comprehensive plan that balances beautiful design with practical functionality. 

A whole-home or multi-room remodel can help you: 

Create a cohesive design throughout your home. 

Improve how your family uses each space. 

Update multiple outdated rooms during one renovation. 

Increase storage and organization. 

Modernize finishes while preserving your home's character. 

Avoid years of piecemeal remodeling projects. 

Stay in the neighborhood you already love.

Is a Whole Home Remodel Right for You?

A Whole Home Remodel St. Paul project isn't only for homes that need extensive renovations. 

Many homeowners choose a comprehensive remodel because several rooms no longer fit their lifestyle. Perhaps the kitchen feels disconnected from the living spaces, the bathrooms need updating, and the basement remains underused. 

A coordinated renovation allows every decision to support the overall vision of the home. 

A whole-home remodel may be a good fit if: 

Several rooms need updating. 

Your layout no longer works for your family. 

You want a more consistent design throughout the house. 

You're planning to stay in your home long term. 

You're considering moving but love your current neighborhood. 

Whole Home Remodeling vs. Multi-Room Remodeling

Homeowners often ask whether there's a difference between a whole-home remodel and a multi-room remodel. 

In reality, the terms are closely related. 

A Multi Room Remodel St. Paul project typically focuses on renovating two or more connected spaces, such as: 

Kitchen and dining room 

Kitchen and primary bathroom 

Main floor living spaces 

Basement and bathroom

Kitchen, mudroom, and laundry room 

A whole-home renovation often expands that vision to include additional living spaces throughout the house. 

Regardless of the scope, the goal remains the same: creating a home that feels cohesive, functional, and thoughtfully designed.

Looking Beyond the Investment 

One of the first questions homeowners ask is about cost. 

Every renovation is unique, so there's no one-size-fits-all answer. Instead of focusing solely on construction costs, it's helpful to consider the complete financial picture. 

Many homeowners throughout St. Paul and Minneapolis currently enjoy mortgage rates that are significantly lower than today's market. Selling your home may mean taking on a higher monthly payment, along with closing costs, moving expenses, and the possibility of purchasing another home that still requires updates. 

For homeowners who already love where they live, investing in a renovation often provides greater long-term value than starting over somewhere new. 

The right decision depends on your home, your goals, and how long you plan to stay. For many homeowners, a Whole House Renovation St. Paul MN project offers better long-term value than starting over in a new home.Many homeowners begin with a Kitchen Remodel St. Paul before expanding the project into adjoining spaces.

What's Included in a Whole House Remodel in St. Paul, MN?

Every project is different, but whole-home renovations commonly include: 

Complete kitchen remodeling 

Primary and guest bathroom renovations 

Basement finishing and remodeling 

Living room updates 

Mudroom and laundry renovations 

Home office design 

Built-in storage 

New flooring throughout the home 

Interior millwork and trim 

Lighting improvements 

Interior reconfiguration 

Custom cabinetry 

A Whole House Remodeling St. Paul MN project can include any combination of the updates below, tailored to your home and lifestyle. Many homeowners begin with a Kitchen Remodel St. Paulbefore expanding the project into adjoining spaces.

Others choose to incorporate St. Paul Bathroom Remodeling alongside their kitchen renovation to create a cohesive main level and primary suite.

Lower levels also become valuable living space through Basement Remodeling In St. Paul, adding recreation rooms, guest areas, fitness spaces, or family gathering rooms.

Why Choose a Whole Home Remodel Contractor in St. Paul?

Working with a design-build company means every phase of the project is managed by one collaborative team, from initial design through construction. 

Instead of coordinating multiple contractors, homeowners enjoy a streamlined experience with clear communication and one unified vision. 

As experienced St. Paul Remodeling Contractors, Wise Design & Remodel guides homeowners through: 

Design consultation 

Space planning 

Material selections 

3D visualization 

Construction planning 

Project management 

Final installation 

Our collaborative approach ensures every room contributes to a cohesive, functional home. 

For homeowners throughout the Twin Cities, Wise Design & Remodel also serves as a trusted Home Remodeling Contractor Minneapolis, helping families create homes designed around the way they live today.

We look forward to hearing from you.

Whether you're considering updating two rooms or transforming your entire home, Wise Design & Remodel can help you create a renovation plan tailored to your lifestyle, your home, and your long-term goals. 

Our collaborative design-build process allows homeowners throughout St. Paul, Minneapolis, and the Twin Cities to enjoy a renovation experience that's organized, transparent, and focused on creating beautiful spaces that work together seamlessly.

Putting the fun in function.  
Honoring original design with craftsmanship, creating innovative ideas for contemporary spaces.  

From Tudors to Craftsmen and stylish modern spaces, we work with you to learn what you love about your home and how you would like it to function. Our team helps find creative solutions to maintain the original character of your home while revitalizing it to fit the way you live today.    

INTERACTIVE SHOWROOM
See products in our showroom

Our showroom is an interactive experience, allowing you to learn how different products will look, function and feel before installing them in your home.  You’ll be able to select cabinetry doors, finishes, hardware, windows, shades, flooring and more without having to drive all over town.  We are a dealer for several lines of products, and bring profound product knowledge directly to your project.

Stay a while and enjoy a sampling from our fully-functioning kitchen, equipped with beverages and taps from our neighborhood breweries.  

CLEAR & TIMELY COMMUNICATION
Staying up to date on your project progress is only a click away.

Our project management software allows you to keep up-to-date with what is happening on your project daily.  Know which contractors to expect to be on-site and if there’s a change in the schedule you will be updated.  

The client portal also gives you direct access to the contracts, plans, scope of work and financials, all in one hub!

ST. PAUL REMODELING TEAM
Architect, Design, Project Management & Craftsmen all in one firm.

Our small but talented team includes a General Contractor, Architect, Kitchenand Bathroom Designers, Project Managers, and Skilled Carpenters. With a full-service team on staff, along with our diligent and trusted trade partners, we are able to collaborate on your project from start to finish. We take pride in delivering an exceptional product with a client experience to match.  

We look forward to hearing from you.

Meet Your Team

Wise Design & Remodel is a Design-build remodeling company serving the Twin Cities and neighboring areas. Our team of dedicated professionals are experienced and passionate about their work. We pride ourselves on remodels that both function well and look amazing, while working hard to make the process as smooth and fun as possible. We look forward to hearing from you about your project.

Design Team

Philip Hide

FOUNDER, GENERAL CONTRACTOR

Philip was born & raised in North London, England, where he started his own remodeling business before bringing his expertise to Minnesota. As many of the homes in London were built in the 1800's, Phil truly specializes in designing smart, creative solutions for old homes without compromising their charm and historicity. Phil met his wife, Julianne, in London where she was studying abroad. They were married in 2007 and continued to live in London for 9 years before moving their family back to Minneapolis in 2014, where he founded Wise Design shortly thereafter. They have 3 children and a German Shepherd dog named Bear. 

Jason Miskowiec

ARCHITECT

Jason has over 15 years of Residential Design experience and holds a Master's in Architecture from the Illinois Institute of Technology, in addition to a Bachelor's in Architecture from the U of M. Working, studying and traveling to destinations such New York, Paris, Chicago, and Oaxaca have all contributed to the inspiration for design he brings to his home and work in Minneapolis. Jason is an avid Viking's fan and loves to travel, where his passions for food, architecture and culture converge. He keeps his office and apartment filled with plants and books, and occasionally brings his beloved dog, Remy, to visit the showroom.

Kim Aaron-Lehman

DESIGNER, KITCHEN & BATH SPECIALIST

Kim has been buying and renovating South Minneapolis homes for over a decade leading up to formally studying Kitchen & Bath Design and joining the Wise Design team. Prior to that, she taught Spanish at the university-level for 11 years and has lived abroad in 4 different countries from Latin America to Europe & the Middle East. As an artist, Kim dabbles in photography, furniture refinishing, painting, and ceramics, and stays busy with part-time property management, having fixed up and rented out 4 homes and a "Skoolie" over the years.

Production Team

Tim Leirness

PROJECT MANAGER

Tim has been in the remodeling industry for nearly 20 years and possesses extensive knowledge of both interior and exterior remodeling. Tim enthusiastically manages our projects with a friendly, client-centered approach. His organizational and communication skills are the key to keeping our operations running smoothly and our clients informed of the daily updates during the construction process. Tim is a devoted husband and father of two. In his free time, he enjoys working out, playing golf, and watching baseball.

Jhony Perez

PROJECT MANAGER, SITE SUPERVISOR

Jhony helps lead the team and supervises the projects. He is a skilled craftsman with over 20 years of experience. His kind and cheerful attitude is appreciated by our clients, who love having him on their projects. Jhony helps train the next generation to be as attentive to detail and proud of their work as he is. A fun fact about Jhony is that his family owns a coffee farm, he generously shares fresh coffee beans with the Wise Design family. Jhony is devoted to his wife and 3 daughters and recently became a Grandpa. 

Derrald Peterson

CABINET SPECIALIST

Derrald has been in the cabinet industry for over 40 years and brings a wealth of knowledge and expertise to the company. Over the years he has honed his cabinet making skills and partnered with many of the top designers in the Twin Cities, completing hundreds of kitchens and custom cabinetry projects. Derrald lives in Minneapolis, is happily married, and has 3 grown sons. He enjoys the outdoors, boating, and photography in his free time.

Nicholas Skarphol

TILING SPECIALIST 

Nick brings his passion for remodeling and expertise as both a Tiler and finish carpenter to the Wise Design Team. He pays close attention to the details and truly loves what he does. Nick’s friendly and caring attitude is always appreciated by our clients. He lives with his Fiancé and loves traveling and outdoor adventures.

Jonathan Kilian

FRAMING & CARPENTRY

Jonathan has come to us from Montpelier Vermont. He has been in the trades for over five years, with experience in the framing and flooring industries. His hobbies are playing guitar, camping, hiking, fly fishing and going to the gym. Jonathan has a passion and enthusiasm for remodeling and construction. He is such a great asset for our team that we forgive him for being a Boston Celtics fan (Go Wolves!).

Chris Dimitrievski

DRYWALL & CARPENTRY

Chris recently moved to the Twin Cities to be closer to his wife's family. His hobbies include Martial Arts, Hiking and Fishing (and remodeling). He is an avid tool collector and when it comes to tools, Chris follows this Mantra:  Better to have it and not need it, than need it and not have it! Chris loves all aspects of remodeling and is a fast learner. We are fortunate to have Chris on the team.

Administrative Team

Sheryll Storry

BOOKKEEPER

Sheryll has been with Wise Design and Remodel since 2018. She spent most of her career in public service, first teaching high school French, then working at Hennepin County, and later the Minnesota Department of Human Services.  After retiring in 2015, she went back to school to become a trained bookkeeper with a focus on the construction trades. While she loves working with numbers, her real passion is helping companies succeed by providing the necessary business intelligence gained from financial analysis. Some fun facts about Sheryll are that she’s an avid gardener, a grandma of 3 teen boys, and a world traveler. 

Julianne Hide

SHOWROOM MANAGER, DESIGN CONSULTANT

Julianne shares Philip’s passion for transforming homes into beautiful and functional living spaces. She helps manage the showroom at Wise Design and assists with designing. Julianne graduated from St. Kate’s University in St. Paul and met Phil in London during a term abroad. They married and lived together in London for 9 years before moving back to Minneapolis and continuing to raise their 3 kids here. Apart from the business, Julianne enjoys music and theatre, yoga and traveling, but most of all loves spending time with her family.

We look forward to hearing from you.
